# Exported internal/core functions that no production code outside their
# package reaches (iss-2609252211487887). The list only shrinks:
# TestEveryExportedCoreFunctionIsReachedOrBaselined, in
# internal/reachaudit/core_reach_test.go, fails on an unreached name missing
# from it, and on a line here that is now reached or no longer exists.
#
# To shrink it, take one name and settle it, then delete its line in the same
# change:
#   - dead scaffolding: delete the function, or wire the front door that
#     calls it (loud-staging.md);
#   - used only inside its own package: unexport it;
#   - a cross-package test seam: rename it ...ForTest.
# Never add a line: a new exported function arrives with its caller.
#
# One "<package dir>.<Name>" per line, sorted and unique.
